cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "name must not be null"
cases.description: Calling findRecords with a null Name should immediately throw IllegalArgumentException before any other checks.
Calling findRecords with a negative DNS type should trigger Type.check and throw IllegalArgumentException before any zone lookup.
Calling findRecords with a type value larger than the 16‑bit DNS type range should cause Type.check to throw IllegalArgumentException.
When the Zone instance has a null 'origin' field, the call to name.subdomain(origin) throws a NullPointerException. This test verifies that findRecords propagates the NPE for a zone with no origin.
